essence: Therefore, the placement of peace must be carried out in three ways.
Thus, householders use a mode ending with stability, while students use one ending with creation.
Therefore, stability is assigned to the innate forest-dweller and creation to seekers of knowledge.
The dissolution sequence runs from kṣa to a.
The praṇava should be enclosed by the mātṛkā letters in the mātṛkā place.
